answer.reason: The tabernacle's story has clear events: it was built by Israel's offerings, reared up by Moses, and filled with the LORD's glory, and later it was set up at Shiloh.

clauses.english: was made by the children of Israel and finished according to all the LORD commanded Moses
clauses.quote: Thus was all the work of the tabernacle of the tent of the congregation finished

clauses.english: was reared up by Moses in the first month of the second year
clauses.quote: in the second year, on the first day of the month, that the tabernacle was reared up

clauses.english: was filled with the glory of the LORD, covered by the cloud
clauses.quote: the glory of the LORD filled the tabernacle

clauses.english: was set up at Shiloh by the whole congregation of Israel
clauses.quote: set up the tabernacle of the congregation there

doubts: Many marked verses (Leviticus, Numbers) only give laws or lists of Levite duties at the tabernacle and were not used.
Several marked verses mention other tabernacles, such as the tabernacle of Moloch in ACT 7:43 (not marked) and the later tabernacle at Gibeon, so they were left out.
Cloud guiding the journeys (EXO 40:36-38) could be a fifth clause but was omitted to keep the line short.
